}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== ===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Rockchip]] RK3528 @2.0GHz Quad-core ARM (Cortex-A53) *GPU: ''Mali-450'' (OpenGL ES2.0); :VPU (with 4K@60fps H265/H264 decoding) *Storage: 8GB (eMMC 5.1) Flash, :TF Card (max.256GB)/MMC Card slot *Memory: 2GB (LPDDR4x) RAM *USB: 2x USB 2.0, 1x USB (Type-C) 2.0 (OTG) ports *Wi-Fi: [[Broadcom]] BCM43752 (SDIO 3.0) :802.11abgn/ac/ax (2T2R), Bluetooth 5.0 (BLE) *Network: 1x 2.5GbE, 1x GbE ports *GPIO: 1x 40-pin connector *Power Source: USB (Type-C) :5V/2.5A or 12V/2A
